title: Compactness of sets with locally uniformly bounded perimeter (Simon Ch. 2, 2.6, for indicator functions)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and let F_i ⊆ ℝ^m (i ∈ ℕ) be measurable sets. Assume that for every R > 0 there are c ∈ ℝ and i_R such that for every i ≥ i_R and every C^∞ vector field φ : ℝ^m → ℝ^m (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) with compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ ball(0, R) and |φ(v)| ≤ 1 for all v, one has ∫_{F_i} div φ dL^m ≤ c, where div φ(v) = trace Dφ(v) and L^m is Lebesgue measure. Then there are a strictly increasing σ : ℕ → ℕ and a measurable F' ⊆ ℝ^m such that L^m((F_{σ(i)} Δ F') ∩ ball(0, R)) → 0 as i → ∞ for every R ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (F i)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ φ : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball 0 R → (∀ v, ‖φ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ v in F i, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ φ v).toLinearMap ≤ c) → ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (F' : Set (Euclid m)), StrictMono σ ∧ MeasurableSet F' ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => volume (symmDiff (F (σ i)) F' ∩ ball 0 R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
